name: @auditforge/qa-checklist
description: AuditForge ISO 42001 pre-publication QA checklist runner: enforces evidence linkage, peer-review approval, candidate-finding resolution, sampling-plan presence, signing-key + TSA anchor, mandatory disclaimers; produces a deterministic pass/fail report consumed by the report-engine before any signed artifact is published. Lead-auditor override with rationale is the only escape hatch (audit-ledger logged).
